newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Lite-On issues $71.3 million GDRs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Lite-On issues $71.3 million GDRs.

text.p: Lite-On Technology Corp, one of Taiwan's leading monitor manufacturers, said on Friday it had completed a US$71.3 million global depositary receipts (GDRs) issue at $14.55 per unit on Thursday.
Lite-On issued a total of 4.9 million units, or 49 million shares, a company spokeswoman said.
"The issue turns out to be about T$40 per share, which is the average share price for Lite-On for the past 60 trading days," she said.
Lite-On had said it would use the funds to finance the construction of its new plants in Scotland and Mexico and to repay foreign currency loans.
Lite-On announced in early July that it would invest US$78 million in Scotland to make monitors.
